title: Artifact: Tridirectional Discriminating-Power Formal Verification of Smart Contract Reentrancy Defense Against Production-Deployed Solidity Source (arXiv:2606.01794)
description: Machine-checked Lean 4 + mathlib4 proof suite establishing the discriminating power of the OpenZeppelin ReentrancyGuard pattern against state-machine models of production-deployed Solidity source. The corpus proves the guard blocks attacks against vulnerable instances (negative leg, DAO 2016), preserves correct execution for non-attacking transactions (positive leg, Compound v2 cToken), and distinguishes structurally-adjacent safe and vulnerable variants (boundary leg, Aave V3 flashLoan vs. a minimal-diff flashLoanVulnerable mutant). A single capstone meta-theorem composes the three protocol instantiations under a no-retrofit composition discipline. All thirteen theorems are kernel-verified with zero sorry, zero user-introduced axioms, and an axiom footprint bounded by [propext], gated under CI across four parallel verification blocks. Companion to arXiv:2606.01794.
